decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - T1  Prunus sp                                Remove deadwood
T2  Prunus sp                                Remove deadwood
T3  Carpinus betulus                     Remove deadwood, branch failure stubs 
                                                      and pruning stubs.
T10 Fraxinus excelsior                  Fell to ground level
T22  Fagus sylvatica                     Sever ivy and undertake decay detection at   
                                                      base. 
(All trees are located along the frontage of the hospital facing Twickenham Road)
Condition : 2 - All work to trees shall be carried out to BS Specification 3998 (As Amended).

Condition : 3 - 































Work must be carried out in line with curerent industry best practicen and that the use of climbing irons (spikes) to enter or move around the tree canopy is strictly prohibited.
description: Following approval for variation of time limit (3 yrs) for approval of reserved matters (condition 3) on planning permission - 01137/E/P24 dated 04/11/1999 for the partial demolition of existing hospital building, construction of a new acute general hospital and development of surplus land for residential use, together with appropriate car parking, landscaping, the formation of a new vehicular access to Park Road and improvements to Park Road/ Twickenham Road junction details submitted pursuant to Condition 10 for tree works for felling of 1 X Fraxinus excelsior, and works to 2 X Cherry trees, 1 X Carpinus betulus and 1 X Fagus covered under planning permission 01137/E/P44 dated 11/01/2005
